history.content: {"success": true, "found_appointment_id": "1234567890123456789", "message": "I found your Thursday the 15th appointment at 9:30 AM with Sarah. Is that the one you'd like to cancel?", "agent_instruction": "AGENT INSTRUCTION, for the caller's next reply only (a newer tool call or result replaces it).
